newsitem.title: ALBANIA: 17 killed in Albanian shooting - agency.
newsitem.headline: 17 killed in Albanian shooting - agency.

text.p: Seventeen people died in a gun battle in a town in central Albania on Thursday, the most violent incident in two months of unrest in the country, the state Albanian news agency ATA said.

It said 16 armed people went to the village of Levan in central Albania and killed a local leader. Angry local people "surrounded the group and killed them all. This is the event with the heaviest toll during the past two months in Albania," ATA said.
It said the 16 gunmen were killed by local people "now armed as many other people in Albania" and indignant at the killing of the chairman of the council of elders of Levan.
It gave no reason for the shooting of the chairman. It did not name any of the dead nor say which political groups they belong to.

Much of southern Albania is ruled by armed rebels who blame Albanian President Sali Berisha for the collapse of popular savings schemes in January in which thousands of people in the former communist state lost their savings.
Berisha is to meet a delegation of European relief experts on Friday to discuss Albania's aid needs as well as a possible multinational force to ensure that humanitarian supplies get through.
